title: 5 Best Delta Exchange Alternatives in India for Crypto Trading in 2026
summary: Compare 5 Delta Exchange alternatives in India for 2026. Find the best crypto platform for futures, options, INR trading, APIs and beginners.
body_markdown:
Delta Exchange India is a popular choice for trading cryptocurrency futures and options. It offers derivatives on assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, API-based trading and contracts with different expiry periods.


However, it may not be the best fit for every trader. Some users may want a simpler interface, a wider selection of spot assets, INR-based futures, different fee structures or better support for API trading.


We compare five leading Delta Exchange alternatives for Indian traders. Instead of declaring one platform the winner, we explain which platform is best suited to each type of user.


> **Important:** Crypto products and derivatives carry substantial risk. Leverage can amplify losses as well as gains. Platform features, fees and contract availability can change, so verify the latest information before opening an account or placing a trade.

## 1. CoinDCX: Best overall Delta Exchange alternative


**Best for:** Traders who want spot, futures, options and API access through one Indian platform.


CoinDCX is the strongest all-round alternative for users who do not want to maintain separate accounts for spot investing and derivatives trading.


The platform supports spot trading alongside INR-margined crypto futures and options. Its futures section covers hundreds of trading pairs, and its API lets traders access market data and manage orders programmatically. CoinDCX’s official platform currently lists spot, futures and[options products,](https://algotest.in/blog/options-trading-a-comprehensive-guide-with-algorithmic-strategies) while its API page includes futures and options trading in INR.


### Where CoinDCX stands out


-


Spot, futures and options on one platform


-


INR-margined futures


-


Dedicated futures API


-


Broad selection of cryptocurrencies


-


Suitable for traders moving from spot to derivatives


### Where it may fall short


The wide product range can make the platform feel busier than a derivatives-only exchange. Traders should also compare the[liquidity,](https://algotest.in/blog/what-is-liquidity-in-trading) fees and available expiries for the exact contracts they intend to trade rather than judging the exchange by its total number of markets.


### CoinDCX vs Delta Exchange India


Choose CoinDCX if you want a broader all-in-one Indian crypto platform. Delta Exchange may remain preferable for traders whose primary focus is its established BTC and ETH options ecosystem.


**Verdict:** CoinDCX is the best overall Delta Exchange alternative for users who want both investing and active trading features.


## 2. CoinSwitch: Best for beginners and accessible options trading


**Best for:** Users who want a simpler interface with room to progress from spot to futures and options.


CoinSwitch was initially associated with beginner-friendly crypto investing, but its trading products now extend beyond simple buying and selling. CoinSwitch Pro supports spot, perpetual futures and cryptocurrency options.


Its[options platform](https://algotest.in/blog/best-crypto-options-trading-platforms-india) currently lists Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana contracts, with features such as daily expiries, order types and market charts. CoinSwitch also provides APIs for market data and automated order execution. CoinSwitch’s official options page lists BTC, ETH and SOL options, while its API platform supports programmatic trading.


### Where CoinSwitch stands out


-


Relatively accessible interface


-


Spot, futures and options access


-


Options for BTC, ETH and SOL


-


API support


-


Suitable for users beginning with smaller or simpler trades


### Where it may fall short


Some CoinSwitch services operate through an aggregation model, and product availability can differ across its interfaces. Options may also use USDT settlement, so traders specifically seeking an entirely INR-settled experience should check the contract details before trading.


### CoinSwitch vs Delta Exchange India


CoinSwitch may suit traders who find Delta Exchange too derivatives-focused and want a more approachable route from spot trading to options. Advanced options traders should compare[strike availability,](https://algotest.in/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-strike-price) liquidity, spreads and multi-leg execution before switching.


**Verdict:** CoinSwitch is a good Delta Exchange alternative for beginners who want a simpler introduction to crypto derivatives.


## 3. Mudrex: Best for INR futures and API trading


**Best for:** Futures traders who want INR margin, broad contract availability and API access.


Mudrex combines spot investing with a dedicated futures platform. It supports INR and USDT-margined futures, real-time profit-and-loss tracking in INR and API-based execution.


The platform advertises more than 500 crypto futures pairs, making it relevant to traders who want exposure beyond BTC and ETH. Its API can be used to build or connect custom futures-trading systems. Mudrex’s futures platform provides INR margin and access to hundreds of pairs, while its API trading page focuses on custom futures execution.


### Where Mudrex stands out


-


INR-margined crypto futures


-


Broad selection of futures pairs


-


Spot and futures within one ecosystem


-


Futures API


-


Suitable for systematic and automated traders


### Where it may fall short


Mudrex is not the closest substitute for someone specifically searching for a complete crypto options platform. Its strongest derivative offering is futures, so options-focused traders may find CoinDCX, CoinSwitch, Pi42 or Delta Exchange more relevant.


### Mudrex vs Delta Exchange India


Choose Mudrex if you primarily trade futures and want broader asset coverage or API access with INR-based tracking. Stay with Delta Exchange if options are central to your trading approach.


**Verdict:** Mudrex is one of the better Delta Exchange alternatives for futures and API traders, but not necessarily for options specialists.


## 4. Pi42: Best for INR-settled crypto derivatives


**Best for:** Traders who want a platform focused specifically on INR-settled futures and options.


Pi42 differs from general crypto exchanges because its main focus is derivatives rather than spot investing. It offers cryptocurrency futures and options with INR settlement, including contracts linked to BTC, ETH and other crypto assets.


Its narrower focus may appeal to traders who want a dedicated derivatives interface without navigating a larger spot-investment ecosystem. Pi42’s official platform positions itself around INR-settled crypto futures and options. Its published fee structure separately lists futures, options, funding and delivery-related charges.


### Where Pi42 stands out


-


Dedicated focus on crypto derivatives


-


INR settlement


-


Futures and options products


-


Clearly published fee categories


-


Relevant for active Indian derivatives traders


### Where it may fall short


Platform-level product availability does not guarantee sufficient liquidity for every strike, expiry or trading pair. Before switching, traders should inspect actual bid-ask spreads, order-book depth and slippage in the contracts they plan to use.


Users who also want extensive spot investing or a broader crypto ecosystem may prefer CoinDCX, CoinSwitch, Mudrex or Binance.


### Pi42 vs Delta Exchange India


Pi42 is one of the closest India-focused alternatives to Delta Exchange because both concentrate heavily on crypto derivatives. The better choice will depend on contract liquidity, available expiries, fees and execution quality for your strategy.


**Verdict:** Pi42 is best for users specifically looking for an INR-focused crypto derivatives platform.

## 5. Binance: Best for global market selection


**Best for:** Experienced traders seeking a large international spot and derivatives ecosystem.


Binance offers spot, margin, futures and options markets across a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Its scale and breadth make it relevant to traders who want access to more markets and advanced trading tools.


The platform reports more than 250 futures and options contracts and provides extensive APIs for market data, order execution and automated trading. Binance also registered as a reporting entity with FIU-IND in 2024. Binance’s India platform lists spot, margin, futures and options, while its regulatory announcement confirms its FIU-IND registration.


### Where Binance stands out


-


Extensive global market coverage


-


Spot, margin, futures and options


-


Advanced order and trading tools


-


Mature API ecosystem


-


Suitable for experienced traders


### Where it may fall short


The funding, settlement and tax-reporting experience may be less straightforward than on platforms designed specifically around Indian users and INR. Some traders may also prefer local customer-support and banking flows.


FIU registration establishes reporting and anti-money-laundering obligations; it does not eliminate market, custody, liquidation or operational risk.


### Binance vs Delta Exchange India


Choose Binance if global market breadth and advanced infrastructure matter more than an INR-native experience. Delta Exchange India may be easier for traders focused on locally accessible BTC and ETH derivatives.


**Verdict:** Binance is best suited to experienced users who prioritise international market selection and advanced tools.


## Which Delta Exchange alternative is best for you?


There is no single best platform for every trader.


-


**Choose CoinDCX** for the best overall combination of spot, futures, options, INR margin and API access.


-


**Choose CoinSwitch** for a more accessible route into spot, futures and options.


-


**Choose Mudrex** for INR-margined futures, broader futures coverage and API trading.


-


**Choose Pi42** for a dedicated INR-settled futures and options platform.


-


**Choose Binance** for extensive global markets and advanced trading infrastructure.


-


**Stay with Delta Exchange India** if its BTC and ETH options liquidity, expiries and derivatives tools already meet your requirements.


## Before switching exchanges, identify the actual problem


Not every trader searching for Delta Exchange alternatives needs a different exchange.

## Final verdict


CoinDCX is a balanced Delta Exchange alternative for Indian users because it combines spot, futures, options and API trading. CoinSwitch is better suited to beginners, while Mudrex is stronger for INR-based futures and custom API execution. Pi42 is the closest specialist alternative for INR-settled derivatives, and Binance provides the broadest global trading ecosystem.


The right platform ultimately depends on what you trade. Compare the specific contracts, liquidity, fees, settlement currency, API reliability and risk controls relevant to your strategy not simply the number of features advertised by each exchange.
